stories.name: Swamp
stories.text: A flooded court has sunk into black water and mushroom stalks. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.

stories.name: Daggerdrome Imp
stories.intro: An imp with knives for fingers drops from a market awning as the sun sets. It cuts at you and laughs as it drinks the blood.
stories.win: The imp grovels and licks its blades clean. It will fly for you now.
stories.lose: It leaves you bleeding by an empty stall.
stories.flee: You run for the lamplight, and it does not follow.

stories.name: Grim Roustabout
stories.intro: A Rakdos roustabout with a grin sewn wide herds you toward a tent. "Death row seats, this way." When you refuse, he grabs a hook.
stories.win: You knock him down, and he gets back up, laughing. He decides he likes you.
stories.lose: He drags you to a seat and you watch the show, bruised.
stories.flee: You slip out before the curtain rises.

stories.name: Thrill-Kill Assassin
stories.intro: A girl in a Massacre Girl mask steps from an alley with a stained blade. Her knife carries poison that kills at a scratch. She is one of many imitators, and she wants your bounty.
stories.win: The mask comes off and she drops the blade. She will kill for you instead of at you.
stories.lose: A shallow cut burns like fire, and she leaves you for dead.
stories.flee: You run, and the laughter follows you for blocks.

stories.name: Ultimate Price
stories.title: Paying a debt
stories.text: An Orzhov assassin called the Cozen waits in a counting-house doorway. He has a contract for a debtor who owes the Syndicate. He offers you a cut if you help him collect. His victim is hiding in the room behind you.

outcome.text: The Cozen counts the coins and hands you the unused curse. "Keep it. Debts come due."
You leave the debtor to his fate.

stories.name: Dead Reveler
stories.intro: A dead man in a party mask staggers out of a Rakdos club. He wants to dance, and he will not take no for an answer. His grip is cold and strong.
stories.win: The reveler collapses into a chair, giggling. He will follow you to the next party.
stories.lose: He spins you into a wall and goes back to his drink.
stories.flee: You leave the club before he finds a partner.

stories.name: Sewer Shambler
stories.intro: A heap of sewer muck rises from a grate. It slides along the gutters faster than you can walk. Its mouth opens wide.
stories.win: The shambler sinks back into the grate. What is left of it follows you, dripping.
stories.lose: It smothers you in filth and leaves you choking.
stories.flee: You climb a wall where it cannot follow.

stories.name: Stab Wound
stories.title: A wound that will not close
stories.text: A man lies in an alley, a cursed wound bleeding under his hand. Each breath costs him more. A Golgari healer crouches over him with a jar of moss. She says the curse must go somewhere.

outcome.text: It burns, but the man stands. You carry the wound away as a weapon.
She draws the curse into her moss and gives you the jar.
You leave the healer to her work.

stories.name: Mind Rot
stories.title: A whisper in the head
stories.text: A Dimir mage whispers from a doorway as you pass. Memories begin to slip away, one by one. You forget why you came here. He smiles.

huge_success.text: You shove the curse back into him. He drops his purse and the spell as he runs.

success.text: You hold on. The curse slips from him to you, waiting to be used.

failure.text: You forget where you packed some of your supplies.

huge_failure.text: You forget where your purse went, and your head aches.

outcome.text: He shrugs, takes the coin, and leaves you with the whisper.
You get away with most of your memories.

stories.name: Perilous Shadow
stories.intro: Your shadow stretches the wrong way under a streetlamp. It peels off the wall and grows with each step it takes. Even the Dimir fear this one.
stories.win: The shadow shrinks back under your feet. It moves when you tell it to now.
stories.lose: It swells over you, and you wake cold in the gutter.
stories.flee: You run for the light, and it fades.

stories.name: Dark Revenant
stories.intro: A winged spirit rises from the steps of an Azorius court. It was set free on a technicality. It swoops at you with clawed hands.
stories.win: The revenant falls, then rises again. It decides to haunt your trail.
stories.lose: Its claws rake you, and it flies off cackling.
stories.flee: You hide in a temple, and it does not follow.

stories.name: Slum Reaper
stories.intro: A spindly reaper with an Orzhov collar stalks a guildless alley. It has come to collect a soul no one will miss. It thinks yours will do.
stories.win: The reaper's collar breaks. It serves you instead, bowing low.
stories.lose: It takes something from you that hurts to lose.
stories.flee: You leave it to its rounds.

stories.name: Catacomb Slug
stories.intro: A slug as big as a cart oozes from a catacomb door. Slime covers the steps behind it. It turns toward you, slow and certain.
stories.win: The slug curls up, beaten. It follows you, leaving a trail.
stories.lose: It rolls over you, and you crawl out covered in slime.
stories.flee: You run, and it does not run after you.

stories.name: Zanikev Locust
stories.intro: A buzzing locust the size of a dog rises from a rot farm. It swoops at your face, mandibles clicking.
stories.win: The locust drops to the ground and buzzes softly. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It bites and flies off with a scrap of your flesh.
stories.flee: You run through the mushroom rows and lose it.

stories.name: Shrieking Affliction
stories.title: A festival shriek
stories.text: A Rakdos festival is in full swing, but people are clutching their ears. A gargoyle perched on a stage screams at a pitch that shatters glass. Those who hear it too long start to bleed. A performer laughs and says the curse is spreading.

choices.text: Climb up and silence the gargoyle

outcome.text: The shriek rattles your bones as you climb.

huge_success.text: You muzzle it with your cloak. The scream breaks into a curse you can carry, and you learn where the performer came from.

success.text: You stop the scream and catch the curse in a jar. The crowd tells you where the performer went.

failure.text: The shriek drives you off the stage, ears ringing.

choices.text: Ask the crowd who started it

outcome.text: A drunk reveler points you to a Rakdos district and hands you a cursed bell.

stories.name: Assassin's Strike
stories.title: A killing curse
stories.text: In the Shanav Quarter, a Selesnya missionary preaches from a step. A hooded figure in the crowd raises a hand and a killing curse gathers there. The missionary has not seen it.

outcome.text: The hooded figure turns on you.

success.text: The missionary dives clear. The assassin flees, and the spent curse falls into your hands.

failure.text: The curse strikes the step, and the assassin vanishes.

huge_failure.text: The assassin turns the curse on you before he goes.

outcome.text: You hurry off before it lands.
